args: $files = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.java src | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force bin | Out-Null; javac -cp ..\SimpleDBEngine\bin -d bin $files

linux.command: mkdir -p bin && find src -name '*.java' -print0 | xargs -0 javac -cp ../SimpleDBEngine/bin -d bin

osx.command: mkdir -p bin && find src -name '*.java' -print0 | xargs -0 javac -cp ../SimpleDBEngine/bin -d bin
